title: Edgar Fouche: the TR3B timeline from prototype to operational

tellings.quote: first actually operational proto or operational models of TR3B started to kind of fly around in the '90s. From the 70s until onward, it was prototype models.

plain: An online UFO researcher known as UAPGerb told Jesse Michels in 2026 about Edgar Fouche, a man who said he worked on secret aircraft projects and spoke at a UFO conference in 1998. According to Fouche, the TR3B, a secret triangle-shaped American aircraft, was flown as prototypes from the 1970s at test sites such as the Navy's Patuxent River station and Edwards Air Force Base, and working models started flying in the 1990s. If true, some sightings of strange craft could have been secret US aircraft.
